content:
Apple One will be even better in iOS 27, with subscribers enjoying new features for bundled services like iCloud+ and Apple Music. Here's the latest.

#1: Get more Apple Intelligence features

iOS 27 includes a slew of major Apple Intelligence upgrades, including an all-new Siri AI, powerful editing tools for Apple Photos, improved image generation, and more.

Although these features will be free for all users, some come with daily usage caps that scale up depending on your Apple One tier.

We don't yet know exactly how much the AI usage caps will increase. But every Apple One plan includes iCloud+, and recent evidence shows that each tier up adds a corresponding increase to the limit.

#2: Four new HomeKit Secure Video upgrades

HomeKit Secure Video is another iCloud+ benefit, and it'll get four new features in iOS 27. According to Apple:

  • 4K Video: "Supported HomeKit Secure Video cameras can now stream and record 4K video"
  • Auto-generated video descriptions: "Users can quickly understand what's happening across a series of video clips without actually watching them"
  • Video clip search: "Users can easily find what they're looking for, like a package delivery"
  • Highlight clips: "At the top of the search page, the Home app will show users highlight clips they may want to revisit, so they can quickly see important moments"

Each improvement will be available to all Apple One subscribers when iOS 27 launches. You just need a compatible smart camera and home hub. My recommendations include:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: just $39, an excellent budget pick
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: supports 4K and is also surprisingly affordable at just $54

#3: Apple Music improvements

Lastly, Apple Music is also getting a slew of new features and improvements in iOS 27.

  • Redesigned artist and album pages
  • iPhone landscape Now Playing interface
  • AutoMix with "even better, more immersive and engaging transitions"
  • AutoMix available on Apple TV and HomePod
  • Hi-Res Lossless Audio streaming support on tvOS 27

Plus, Lyrics Translation and Lyrics Pronunciation are expanding to more languages. According to Apple:

Lyrics Translation will expand to seven new language pairs, seamlessly translating the lyrics of users' favorite songs, including English to French, English to German, English to Italian, English to Korean, English to Spanish, French to English, and Japanese to English. […] Lyrics Pronunciation, which lets users sing along with the lyrics of another language, will also expand to five new pairs, including Arabic to Romanized Arabic, English to Korean alphabet, English to Katakana, Japanese to Korean alphabet, and Simplified Chinese (Mandarin) to Katakana.

Apple also highlighted several important bug fixes for improved streaming stability, faster loading of the Now Playing interface, quicker playback launch, and more.

Which new Apple One feature in iOS 27 are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.

Apple One starts at $19.95/month and includes Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.
